title: School-based therapy staffing: proposed domain specification
status: Proposed; no live adapters, jurisdiction approval or operational readiness.

observed_inputs.interpretation: Public workflow categories and proposed controls; not private Amergis schema.
Caseload differs from workload; direct/indirect duties need approved allocation, not a universal threshold.

basis.source_claim_boundary: All schemas, roles, states and commands are proposed, not Amergis private interfaces.

scope.illustrative_role: Speech-language pathologist (SLP); OT/PT are separately approved variations.
scope.unit: One provider, school-authorized slot, worksite and work block under a term assignment; one employer per tenant. Multi-session/multi-school routing remains unmodeled.
excluded: IEP/clinical eligibility, plans, minutes or treatment decisions
unresolved_launch_gates: Executed terms, calendar, workload and actual pay/bill rules
School-owned service system and permitted projections
scope.hard_rule: Unknown required authority/check/supervision/workload rule blocks commitment. Synthetic tests never authorize production.

type_definitions.uuid: UUID string; references must resolve within tenant.
type_definitions.reference: Opaque owning-system/type ID. Evidence adds location/hash/time. No raw secrets.
type_definitions.interval: start/end UTC instants; end greater than start; end nullable only where field explicitly permits.
type_definitions.zoned_interval: UTC start/end, original local values, IANA zone, explicit offset/fold for DST.
type_definitions.decimal: Base-10 string; no binary float for money or hours.
type_definitions.money: Decimal amount, ISO currency and unit; no inferred weekly/hourly conversion.
type_definitions.approval_ref: Immutable actor/authority, object version, payload hash, policy, validity interval and status.
type_definitions.role_ref: Role ID with effective tenant/client/worksite/purpose scope.

fields: Required on every business row/event; server-derived
Starts 1; monotonically increments on accepted mutation
State from linked model when applicable
Reject unknown state; only specified commands may change
Keep raw source identity separate from our object ID
common_fields.field_inheritance: Every object inherits; conflicting masters block setup.

privacy_classes.definition: Nonpublic operational metadata; authenticated tenant access.
Worker/client identifiable information; purpose- and role-limited.
Medical/identity/screening/financial/incident or sensitive consent evidence; separate encryption, purpose-specific authorization and audited access.

objects.name: Provider and scoped consent
objects.authority: Staffing core: provider identity/contact. Consent ledger: immutable scope/signature revisions. Distinct field masters linked by worker_id.
fields: Unique per tenant; identity merge requires documented owner approval
Match status recorded; raw identity documents not in workflow payload
Honor channel opt-out; verification does not itself give marketing consent
Named purpose, channel, recipient and data categories
No blanket inferred consent; scope must match actual command
Signer, text version, timestamp and evidence hash required before ACTIVE
UTC instant; cannot precede signed event without owner-reviewed correction
Set only from approved scope/policy; null does not override withdrawal
Same worker/tenant; never erase prior record

objects.name: District/client and school worksite
objects.authority: Staffing core: district/school profile. Policy service: approved requirement references.
fields: Legal entity verified by account owner
Approved scope and access; public office directory is not district authorization
State and locality required before production; normalized address plus original
Valid IANA zone; never infer from browser
Verified delegation, worksite scope, effective dates
Same worksite or explicit inherited scope
Exactly one source master per worksite/effective interval
Closures, holidays and in-service days source-verified; no automatic unpaid-day inference
Staffing system stores authorized references/aggregates, not student clinical records

objects.name: Requirement and rate policy version
objects.authority: Policy service: approved immutable rules. Executed documents: original evidence.
fields: New version for any approved rule change
Explicit therapy discipline and pilot geography; unresolved scope blocks release
Start < end if finite; precedence resolves overlaps
Discipline/state/school checks, education authorization, supervision and approved workload constraints
Authority, stage, reviewer and freshness per rule; professional and school requirements are independent.
Decimal amount, currency, unit and effective dates; no inferred wages
Separate from pay; decimal amount/currency/unit, trigger and supporting evidence
Page/clause and hash; ambiguous interpretation is unresolved
Exact payload hash; all necessary authorities required
Production blocked until owner-approved schedule exists
Approved direct service, evaluation, documentation, IEP meeting, consultation, supervision and travel duties
Record approved units/constraints; caseload count ≠ workload and service minutes ≠ paid hours; no universal caseload maximum

objects.name: Requisition
objects.authority: Selected staffing core only; workflow store holds source IDs/events, not competing editable orders.
fields: Term assignment reference retained; multi-block schedules create individually checked work blocks
Source channel, authorized person, timestamp; competitor job listing insufficient
SLP is worked example; OT/PT need their own approved qualification/scope matrix
Positive UTC interval with local time/zone/fold; service sessions may occupy only part
Approved and effective for full requested interval
Exactly 1 per bounded block; not student caseload
No publication until current approved pay/units and consent policy
Dates/worksite/calendar version; cannot infer guarantee of paid hours
Approved aggregate service and indirect-duty expectations
No student-level IEP content; unknown feasibility routes school and clinician
Source school authority; staffing agents cannot change eligibility/required minutes or treatment plans

objects.name: Provider submission
objects.authority: Staffing core: submission/outcome. Consent/clearance authorities remain referenced.
fields: ACTIVE and scope valid at send
Pinned policy version; no inferred protected traits
No unsupported competency assertions; restrict medical/source reports
Binds payload, recipient and current evidence
Human client actor, reason, timestamp; not model-generated judgment

objects.name: Provider qualification and readiness snapshot
objects.authority: Restricted readiness service: snapshot. Issuer/provider: verification. Qualified reviewers: clearance.
fields: Never portable across scopes without recomputation
Exact reference; unresolved name mismatch blocks READY
Same tenant/client; must match assignment worksite
Shift interval this snapshot can authorize
All time-dependent prerequisites cover full interval
Each has requirement_id, source_ref, verification_time, identity_match, validity, status; OCR not verification
Relevant consent, stage, examination/attestation and employment setup outcomes
Qualified owners verify required completion; model cannot attest
Qualified discipline/supervision and relevant HR decisions
Approved district/state/role rules; no agent competency/scope judgment; assistants/trainees out of pilot scope
Required for READY; snapshot hash and reviewer qualification
Deterministically derived from approved matrix; UNKNOWN cannot be READY

objects.name: School assignment and work block
objects.authority: Staffing core: assignment. One atomic reservation service: worker/slot locks with confirmed IDs synchronized.
fields: One worker, one requisition slot, one shift
Unique occupied slot, no overlapping committed worker interval
Same tenant; readiness bound to this worker
Preserve zone/offset; approved school calendar and workload profile; not synonymous with therapy session
READY and valid for full shift, revalidate at reservation, confirmation and start
Worker agreement and client authorization reference exact version
Lock token, fencing sequence and expiry
Unique active slot+worker locks; expiration releases only unconfirmed reservation
Status never deletes a claim of actual work
Does not override block readiness, calendar or worker agreement
School-owned schedule or approved aggregate coverage reference
No identifiable student clinical content; changes need school and qualified clinician approval

objects.name: Worked time and minimal service-evidence references
objects.authority: Designated time source: original facts. Pay-review service: normalized revisions/decision. No overwrite of source.
fields: Immutable submitted facts; correction creates linked revision
Null permitted for unmatched work claim; owner reconciles without deleting claim.
Source payload hash; retain original and corrections
Actual claimed work intervals labeled direct service, documentation, evaluation, meeting, consultation, supervision, travel or other approved duty
Keep zoned intervals/source; paid-work rules distinct from billable service units; anomalies route review
Missing client signature must not erase it
Contract-selected invoice evidence; independent of actual hours owed
Payroll owner decision, payable units, rule version, due-risk
Unknown/contested work escalated before applicable cutoff; client nonapproval alone cannot set zero pay
Same source lineage; export correction uses adjustment, not deletion
Prevent duplicate payable revision; trace adjustments
Opaque school-owned service/attendance evidence and authorized aggregate units
No student identifiers, diagnosis or clinical note content; evidence permissions/contract determine billing; absence does not prove no work

objects.name: Payroll preparation batch
objects.authority: Preparation service: proposed batch/approval. Payroll provider: sole payroll/settlement ledger.
fields: Employer and tenant mapping required; no cross-account dispatch
Approved jurisdiction/employer schedule; unknown schedule blocks live pilot
Time revision, worker provider ID, pay-rule inputs
PAY_READY or EXPORTED only to this batch; approved adjustments; no client approval prerequisite
Decimal units/currency, expected totals, anomaly disposition
Required before dispatch; binds provider, lines, amounts, date and hash
Persist request key before call; unknown result requires lookup, not new release
SENT is not paid; record rejects without canceling earned-pay obligations

objects.name: Invoice preparation and mirror
objects.authority: Preparation service: draft/approval. Accounting provider: issued numbers, posting, credits and receipts.
fields: One unique source-line allocation per billable revision
Time evidence, units, bill rules and computed amounts
Required client approval/support attached; independently calculated from payroll
Billing authority approves exact issue payload
Required for initial pilot; binds recipient/account/amount/currency
No invented payment terms; unresolved trigger blocks issue
Provider receipts or client dispute evidence
Issued financial values immutable; credits handled by authorized provider flow

objects.name: School/provider incident and service case
objects.authority: Restricted case service: status/evidence. Qualified clinical/HR/school people: substantive decisions.
fields: Provider/district/work-block references; school-owned restricted case link when needed
No student clinical detail in staffing ATS; school case authority and minimum-necessary access
Preserve source timestamp and receipt timestamp
Restricted storage; discourage student identifiers in intake
Uncertain possible safety concern escalates; no AI clinical disposition
Clinical, HR or operations authority appropriate to case
No waiting for model completion or routine queue if emergency indicated
Qualified decision and corrective action evidence
Exact owner, rationale and completion verification

objects.name: Command, approval and audit event
objects.authority: Append-only audit ledger: commands/approvals. Administrators and agents cannot rewrite history.
fields: Unique tenant+command namespace; same key/different payload returns conflict
Includes target version, recipients, amounts and effective policy
Authenticated server-side; model supplied role is untrusted
Record used versions and evidence refs; no hidden approval inference
Cannot self-approve; changed payload invalidates approval
Unknown external result enters reconciliation; never treated as success
Unique inbox/outbox event key; consume stateful feeds only in approved integration
Inputs, result and reconciled external evidence
Least-privilege links; redact secrets/raw medical payloads

state_models.name: Scoped consent

transitions.prerequisites: Verified worker deliberately signs displayed scope/version.
transitions.evidence_required: Signed scope artifact and timestamp.
transitions.output: Activated immutable consent revision.
transitions.on_exception: Reject unverified signer or changed text; remain DRAFT.

transitions.prerequisites: Worker request or verified representative request; recruiter only records evidence.
transitions.evidence_required: Withdrawal request and affected scopes.
transitions.output: Stop future affected actions; notify downstream consent index.
transitions.on_exception: Escalate identity uncertainty; suppress optional outreach while resolving.

transitions.prerequisites: Configured expiry reached under approved policy.
transitions.evidence_required: Policy expiry and trusted clock.
transitions.output: Expired consent; reconsent required.
transitions.on_exception: No invented expiry; unresolved rule owner review.

invariants: Withdrawal does not delete lawful historical records or automatically cancel payroll.
Use of consent at send time requires scope, recipient, purpose and current ACTIVE state.

state_models.name: Single school staffing work-block request

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized school order, approved discipline/state/school policy, term/calendar, complete work block and realistic school/clinician-approved workload.
transitions.evidence_required: School order, requirement and workload versions; direct/indirect duty expectations.
transitions.output: Open requisition and optional approved publication request.
transitions.on_exception: Keep DRAFT; route missing contract, state, wage unit or clinical requirement.

transitions.prerequisites: Slot filled or request period ended with documented owner rule; no new submissions.
transitions.evidence_required: Fulfillment/end evidence and related assignments.
transitions.output: Order closed; existing assignments preserved.
transitions.on_exception: Never imply assignment cancellation; route conflicting obligations.

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized withdrawal of demand; identify all affected assignments.
transitions.evidence_required: Client instruction and cancellation-case links.
transitions.output: Order canceled; separate assignment resolution tasks.
transitions.on_exception: Never silently cancel committed shifts or suppress pay.

invariants: One provider slot per work block; multi-provider/multi-block orders split into explicit linked records.
OPEN terms/workload changes require close/new linked request with school/worker approval; no hidden change to accepted assignment or student services.

state_models.name: Candidate submission

transitions.prerequisites: OPEN order, worker ACTIVE scoped consent, approved job criteria, complete truthful package, exact recruiter approval.
transitions.evidence_required: Consent, qualification evidence, recruiter approval, recipient scope.
transitions.output: Submitted package and receipt/outbox reference.
transitions.on_exception: Block send; no automatic exclusion or unsupported claims.

transitions.prerequisites: Authenticated authorized client accepts; recruiter may record client source only.
transitions.evidence_required: Client decision with actor/time and exact package.
transitions.output: Accepted submission; readiness and booking still separate.
transitions.on_exception: Unverified reply remains pending; no assumed acceptance.

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized client decision; required employment review path applied for relevant reason.
transitions.evidence_required: Client decision, job-related reason and applicable review reference.
transitions.output: Declined record with accessible challenge route.
transitions.on_exception: Never act solely on model score, protected inference or unreviewed adverse report.

transitions.prerequisites: Worker withdrawal or owner-documented order withdrawal.
transitions.evidence_required: Verified request/reason.
transitions.output: Stop pending submission processing; retain audit.
transitions.on_exception: If already accepted resolve related assignment separately.

invariants: ACCEPTED is client outcome only, not work authorization or assignment confirmation.
External send timeout records pending/unknown command; SUBMITTED only after durable dispatch acknowledgement or reconciliation.

state_models.name: Readiness snapshot

transitions.prerequisites: Complete person-matched professional, education, school clearance and any supervision/HR checks under approved matrix for full work block.
transitions.evidence_required: Check inventory and authoritative evidence refs.
transitions.output: Frozen readiness package for qualified owner.
transitions.on_exception: Stay INCOMPLETE; missing/unknown evidence is not a pass.

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized qualified owner verifies all required checks and required clinical/HR decisions; no unresolved restriction.
transitions.evidence_required: Exact snapshot approval plus qualification/delegation.
transitions.output: READY snapshot and deterministic valid_until.
transitions.on_exception: BLOCKED or INCOMPLETE route; agent cannot approve.

transitions.prerequisites: Reviewer identifies ambiguity, adverse result or unfulfilled requirement.
transitions.evidence_required: Reason and appropriate restricted case reference.
transitions.output: BLOCKED; no booking eligibility.
transitions.on_exception: Never automatically reject employment or disclose protected report.

transitions.prerequisites: New relevant evidence or correction received.
transitions.evidence_required: New evidence versions; earlier decision preserved.
transitions.output: Recompute complete checklist then request fresh review.
transitions.on_exception: Never jump directly to READY.

transitions.prerequisites: Policy superseded, verified conflict/restriction, identity mismatch or scope changed.
transitions.evidence_required: Invalidation trigger and impacted assignment IDs.
transitions.output: Snapshot unusable; hold unstarted assignments and alert staffed route for underway shifts.
transitions.on_exception: Urgent concerns notify immediately; no AI clinical instructions.

transitions.prerequisites: Trusted clock passes valid_until or full shift can no longer fit validity.
transitions.evidence_required: Validity computation and clock.
transitions.output: Unusable snapshot; same downstream controls as invalidation.
transitions.on_exception: If expiry unknown treat not-ready, escalate rule owner.

invariants: All required evidence and applicable practice authority cover full shift at reserve, confirm and start.
READY is time/scope-specific; employment status and general consent are not universal clearance.

state_models.name: Single school assignment work block

transitions.prerequisites: Open school slot; accepted submission or approved direct-book rule; worker agreement; READY scoped snapshot; approved school calendar/workload; no time conflict.
transitions.evidence_required: Readiness/terms version, consent and atomic worker+slot lock.
transitions.output: Fenced reservation with expiry; both conflict locks acquired atomically.
transitions.on_exception: 409 conflict or validation failure leaves DRAFT; offer alternatives only.

transitions.prerequisites: Reservation unexpired, worker/client confirmation evidence, current requirements and accepted terms unchanged; revalidate locks/readiness.
transitions.evidence_required: Both confirmations and current validation result.
transitions.output: Committed shift and idempotent confirmation messages.
transitions.on_exception: Release expired reservation or HOLD if readiness changed.

transitions.prerequisites: Readiness invalid/expired, school closure, disputed schedule, authorization or conflict before work starts.
transitions.evidence_required: Trigger and responsible resolution owner.
transitions.output: Prevent start authorization; route school/clinician/scheduler resolution and worker notice; preserve pay/service questions.
transitions.on_exception: Never present hold as employment rejection or clinical advice.

transitions.prerequisites: Owners resolve trigger; school/clinician approves changed service schedule/workload; worker accepts terms; READY current. Atomically reacquire/validate worker+slot locks with fencing.
transitions.evidence_required: Resolution, readiness and confirmation refs.
transitions.output: Reconfirmed shift with new validation snapshot.
transitions.on_exception: Remain HOLD; missing requirements cannot be waived by scheduler/agent.

transitions.prerequisites: Actual check-in evidence; current scoped readiness and booking validations pass at start.
transitions.evidence_required: Worker/client authorized check-in and server validation.
transitions.output: Work-start event; time record can accrue.
transitions.on_exception: Block system authorization, alert staffed owner; retain any claim actual work occurred.

transitions.prerequisites: Actual end or early termination reported; reconcile claimed interval separately.
transitions.evidence_required: Check-out/report evidence.
transitions.output: Completed shift and time-review task.
transitions.on_exception: Missing client approval does not delete work; time dispute queue.

transitions.prerequisites: Verified authorized cancellation/closure or unconfirmed reservation expiry; worker claims and missed-service obligations remain separate cases.
transitions.evidence_required: Request, effective time, policy and notice evidence.
transitions.output: Release block locks; payroll and school-directed makeup review remain open if applicable.
transitions.on_exception: No cancel of IN_PROGRESS; close actual work and preserve payable claims.

transitions.prerequisites: Staffed owner verifies nonattendance after approved attempts; preserve contrary worker evidence.
transitions.evidence_required: Attendance check and contact attempts.
transitions.output: No-show record, coverage request and case.
transitions.on_exception: Unknown attendance stays under investigation; no automatic wage conclusion.

invariants: Readiness changes after IN_PROGRESS create urgent incident/escalation; never erase actual work or let an agent decide clinical continuation.
Cancellation/no-show labels do not settle compensable-time or fee questions.
Confirmation messages dispatched via command outbox; failed delivery is an exception, not a second booking.

School closure, absence or missed session creates a scheduling exception; rescheduling/makeup is only proposed until school and qualified clinician authorize the service plan/schedule and worker accepts terms.
Service-minute obligations, eligibility and clinical plans remain school/clinician-owned. Work-block state never changes them.
An ended/missed session does not determine whether documentation, meetings or other compensable work occurred.

state_models.name: Time revision and pay readiness

transitions.prerequisites: Source record or worker work claim with source provenance; no need for client approval to preserve claim.
transitions.evidence_required: Original segments, source hash and worker/source identity.
transitions.output: Immutable submitted revision and independent billing review.
transitions.on_exception: Retain malformed work claim as exception; no silent deletion.

transitions.prerequisites: Missing/conflicting hours, overlap, disputed break, rule ambiguity or cutoff risk.
transitions.evidence_required: Anomaly evidence and deadline.
transitions.output: Staffed payroll review task; billing dispute remains independent.
transitions.on_exception: Never freeze all undisputed pay merely because one line is contested.

transitions.prerequisites: Payroll owner determines actual compensable work across direct/indirect duties under approved rules; unresolved claims escalated before deadline, independent of school service-minute dispute.
transitions.evidence_required: Work evidence, owner decision, rules and unresolved-claim case link if applicable.
transitions.output: Payable revision eligible for batch regardless of missing client invoice approval.
transitions.on_exception: No model conclusion of zero owed; unresolved statutory timing goes to qualified owner.

transitions.prerequisites: Unique payable revision allocated to one batch/adjustment; all source and rule references intact.
transitions.evidence_required: Batch ID and allocation acknowledgment.
transitions.output: Export link; later correction becomes linked adjustment.
transitions.on_exception: On unknown result reconcile allocation; never allocate duplicate.

transitions.prerequisites: Documented duplicate/superseded record; no allocation/dispatch yet; every work claim transferred to an identified live record.
transitions.evidence_required: Replacement ID and owner reconciliation; no extinguished claim.
transitions.output: Void revision while preserving source and replacement link.
transitions.on_exception: Cannot void because client disputes time or worker is no-show; retain payroll review.

invariants: Billing approval/dispute is an orthogonal sourced decision, not a prerequisite for PAY_READY.
Export is preparation only, not settlement.
Claim revisions cannot overwrite exported payroll inputs; adjustment links preserve traceability.
School-owned service evidence/aggregate units may support contract billing but do not replace actual worked time.
Direct treatment, indirect duties, evaluation, meetings, supervision and travel require applicable pay/workload rules; no universal session-to-pay conversion.

state_models.name: Payroll preparation and settlement mirror

transitions.prerequisites: Unique PAY_READY lines or EXPORTED lines allocated only to this batch/adjustment; employer/provider mapping, approved pay rules and deterministic/provider calculation.
transitions.evidence_required: Totals, exceptions, source allocations and hash.
transitions.output: Frozen release package.
transitions.on_exception: Keep DRAFT and route incomplete/ambiguous items; escalate payroll deadline.

transitions.prerequisites: Correction needed before any dispatch attempt.
transitions.evidence_required: Reason and invalidated approval reference.
transitions.output: New editable revision; prior approval unusable.
transitions.on_exception: After attempt use reconciliation/provider correction, never edit original.

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized financial owner approves exact account/date/lines/totals; segregation policy met.
transitions.evidence_required: Authenticated exact-payload approval.
transitions.output: Release authorization with expiry and owner.
transitions.on_exception: AI cannot approve; changed hash requires new review.

transitions.prerequisites: Current matching approval; durable unique operation/outbox record committed before external request.
transitions.evidence_required: Approval hash, provider mapping and idempotency key.
transitions.output: Dispatch attempt ledger; SENT means attempted, not paid.
transitions.on_exception: Network ambiguity -> RECONCILING; no fresh key or second release.

transitions.prerequisites: An attempt exists, whether acknowledged, pending or unknown.
transitions.evidence_required: Provider lookup/event identity and original key.
transitions.output: Reconciliation record pending definitive outcome.
transitions.on_exception: Provider outage keeps RECONCILING and alerts deadline owner; read-only status retries.

transitions.prerequisites: Authenticated authoritative provider settlement and line/total match.
transitions.evidence_required: Settlement evidence and reconciliation result.
transitions.output: Settlement mirror and exceptions closed only if resolved.
transitions.on_exception: Partial/mismatched outcome remains RECONCILING; owner resolves lines.

transitions.prerequisites: Provider definitively rejected operation with no settlement; owner confirms outcome.
transitions.evidence_required: Definitive rejection plus no-success reconciliation.
transitions.output: Rejected batch; unresolved pay obligations transfer to new linked correction batch.
transitions.on_exception: Unknown outcome cannot be rejected/reissued.

transitions.prerequisites: No dispatch attempt; obligations carried into replacement batch or reasoned no-obligation record.
transitions.evidence_required: Owner cancellation and replacement/case references.
transitions.output: Void preparation only.
transitions.on_exception: Cannot void settled/sent batch to undo payment.

invariants: An authorized payroll account and approved jurisdiction/pay schedule are launch gates.
REJECTED/VOIDED do not cancel worker-pay obligations.
Partial settlement remains RECONCILING until every line has a reconciled outcome; failed lines use linked correction, not replay.

state_models.name: Invoice preparation and provider mirror

transitions.prerequisites: Approved contract billing units/rules, required school approval/service-evidence refs and unique allocations; never assume therapy minutes equal worked hours.
transitions.evidence_required: Line calculations, evidence, due-basis and payload hash.
transitions.output: Frozen invoice issue package.
transitions.on_exception: Hold affected billing line; continue separate worker-pay review.

transitions.prerequisites: Correction needed before external dispatch.
transitions.evidence_required: Reason and invalidated approval.
transitions.output: New draft version.
transitions.on_exception: If external outcome unknown reconcile first; no new invoice key.

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized billing owner approves exact legal party, account, amounts, dates and supporting data.
transitions.evidence_required: Exact payload approval.
transitions.output: Current issue authorization.
transitions.on_exception: No model-only issue approval in initial pilot.

transitions.prerequisites: Matching approval; durable unique outbox and external invoice operation; ISSUED only on confirmed provider issue.
transitions.evidence_required: Provider invoice number/ack and original key.
transitions.output: Issued immutable provider mirror and delivery evidence.
transitions.on_exception: Timeout stays AUTHORIZED with command outcome unknown and dispatch lock; lookup before retry; block edit/void while pending.

transitions.prerequisites: Client dispute with invoice identity.
transitions.evidence_required: Verified dispute and claimed lines.
transitions.output: Assigned billing case; unrelated payroll unaffected.
transitions.on_exception: Unknown invoice goes to unmatched case; never mutate invoice.

transitions.prerequisites: Authorized resolution leaves original valid, or provider-approved credit/replacement references reconcile difference.
transitions.evidence_required: Resolution and any provider credit/correction evidence.
transitions.output: Resolved receivable mirrored; original invoice retained.
transitions.on_exception: Unresolved amount/authority remains DISPUTED; credits not agent-issued.

transitions.prerequisites: Provider receipts/authorized credits fully reconcile outstanding balance; disputes resolved or separately documented.
transitions.evidence_required: Matched accounting events; full balance computation.
transitions.output: Paid/settled mirror.
transitions.on_exception: Partial/unmatched receipts remain current state; append evidence only.

transitions.prerequisites: Never externally issued and no pending/unknown dispatch; allocations released with trace.
transitions.evidence_required: Owner cancellation reason.
transitions.output: Preparation voided.
transitions.on_exception: Issued invoice cancellation/credit uses accounting authority and separate linked evidence, not this command.

invariants: Accounting provider is authoritative for issue, credits and payment, not this state mirror.
Partial receipts and dispute notes append audit facts without inventing extra states.
Issue/release failures cannot silently change payroll state.

state_models.name: Restricted incident and service case

transitions.prerequisites: Immediate urgent routing already attempted when indicated; agent only categorizes/routs under approved escalation policy.
transitions.evidence_required: Original report, notification attempts, owner and priority.
transitions.output: Staffed accountable owner assigned.
transitions.on_exception: No acknowledgment escalates backup route; never waits on full intake.

transitions.prerequisites: Qualified responsible person accepts case; need-to-know scope established.
transitions.evidence_required: Owner acknowledgment/qualification.
transitions.output: Human-led review started.
transitions.on_exception: Wrong owner -> staffed reroute with audit; no unqualified clinical decision.

transitions.prerequisites: Appropriate clinical/HR/operations owner decides action within authority.
transitions.evidence_required: Decision, rationale, assignee and due trigger.
transitions.output: Tracked action list; agent may arrange approved logistics.
transitions.on_exception: Ambiguous authority routes supervisor; no autonomous adverse/clinical action.

transitions.prerequisites: Owner verifies no further action needed or required actions completed; affected payroll/employment obligations tracked separately.
transitions.evidence_required: Resolution, action evidence and residual-case refs.
transitions.output: Resolution awaiting closure check.
transitions.on_exception: Incomplete evidence stays current; cannot close solely on generated summary.

transitions.prerequisites: Required follow-up, communications and restricted retention tagging complete.
transitions.evidence_required: Owner closure checklist.
transitions.output: Closed immutable case; recurrence creates linked case.
transitions.on_exception: Missing follow-up remains RESOLVED.

invariants: School/student safety concerns immediately route through the approved staffed school/clinical/emergency pathway; agents do not diagnose, determine eligibility or change therapy.
School owns student clinical/service plans and records; staffing case stores only minimal authorized reference/status.

permission_matrix.conditions: Verified identity; only own records and worker-safe projection.
Active worksite/action delegation; masked worker projection.
Credential scope plus necessary clinical/HR decision references; no implied professional authority.
Recorded qualification, case membership, appropriate sub-scope; no bulk data access.
Readiness outcome only; no waiver of missing credential/terms.
Employer/account scope; release exact hash; apply segregation policy.
Customer/account scope; payroll data only minimum necessary for reconciliation.
Case membership; substantive decisions within separately granted authority.
Business access/approvals denied by default; independent approval for privileged changes.
Per-command scope/field masks and delegation; exact approval where required. Cannot grant roles, approve own actions, choose clinical/adverse outcomes or release funds autonomously.

server_checks: Validate schema, same-tenant references, version, transition and field permission.
Resolve applicable approved policy; unknown requirements block affected action.
Audit decision before dispatch and reconcile outcome.
At dispatch, approval is current/unrevoked; approver still authorized under current policy.

responses.accepted: result with new object version/event ID; external attempts may be pending.
responses.conflict: 409 stale version, occupied slot or reused key/different payload; caller reloads and replans, not blind retry.
responses.invalid: 422 missing rule/evidence or schema failure; no state change.
responses.unknown_external: 202 pending reconciliation with stable operation key; never claim successful effect.

rules: Only declared transitions may change state; non-modeled records follow field authority.
Creation validates references and initializes only the model initial state.
Key namespace: tenant + command + operation. Same key/hash returns prior result; different hash conflicts.
Deduplicate inbound events by provider account/event ID. Reconcile stale/out-of-order versions.
Commit outbox/approval/key before external call. Test provider idempotency; if absent serialize, lookup and require reconciliation before resend.
Agents cannot bypass gateway via direct DB/provider UI writes.
Rejected commands preserve state and audit reason. Urgent notification runs independently.
Key retention covers reconciliation/retry and record schedule; no invented universal TTL.

approval_meanings.policy: Authenticated actor or scoped delegation; no implicit AI decision authority.
approval_meanings.exact_owner: Authorized person approves exact payload; listed agent may dispatch only with matching current approval.

retry_profiles.semantics: Retry same key/hash after transient error; return prior commit. Stale version requires reload and reviewed new intent.

After timeout reconcile original key first. Resend only with proven provider idempotency or authoritative no-effect outcome. Unknown/partial effect blocks new release, edit or void; alert deadline owner.

non_transition_operations.name: record.create
non_transition_operations.actors: Object owner or scoped intake agent
non_transition_operations.contract: Validate required_at_create and initial state via DS-CMD-RULES. Route external-master creation through selected adapter; no dual editable masters.

non_transition_operations.name: evidence.append
non_transition_operations.contract: Append same-tenant immutable hash/provenance link; never alter readiness, settlement or decision state.

non_transition_operations.name: time.record_client_decision
non_transition_operations.actors: Authorized client approver or agent recording authenticated source
non_transition_operations.contract: Append authenticated independent billing_decision_ref via gateway; never change payroll state or delete work claims.

non_transition_operations.name: incident.notify_urgent
non_transition_operations.contract: Immediately enqueue approved staffed route with minimal necessary facts; record attempts and acknowledgments, retry/escalate backup route under policy. Do not wait for complete intake or make clinical decision.

non_transition_operations.name: assignment.report_underway_concern
non_transition_operations.contract: Preserve IN_PROGRESS facts, create restricted incident and route staffed clinical owner; no AI authorization of continued clinical care.

non_transition_operations.name: financial.append_provider_event
non_transition_operations.actors: Authenticated adapter and scoped reconciliation owner
non_transition_operations.contract: Deduplicate account/event ID, append provider evidence, then invoke explicit permitted transition if preconditions met. Read-only lookup may poll under bounded retry policy.

non_transition_operations.name: school.propose_makeup_or_schedule_change
non_transition_operations.contract: Create proposal referencing school-owned schedule, calendar, clinician-approved requirements and worker availability. No automatic change to IEP service minutes, eligibility, clinical plans, owed makeups or committed terms; obtain school/clinician approval and worker acceptance, then create/revalidate work block.

tenant_and_storage_controls: Tenant row scopes and foreign-key checks apply to database, queues, object storage, search/vector index, caches, exports and logs.
Client/worksite membership adds a second boundary inside tenant; workers see own data, not tenant-wide pool.
Agents receive purpose-limited projections, no raw medical/background files or banking credentials by default.
Provider account/connection is tenant-bound; webhook signatures and provider account mapping validated before use.
Cross-tenant or cross-client record discovery returns no existence/detail leak; authorization evaluated before search and retrieval.
No production personal records in test fixtures or model evaluation by default; use synthetic workers.
Student clinical/service records are out of scope. Incident intake minimizes identifiers and routes necessary care details to authorized clinical channels.
Break-glass sensitive access requires explicit time-limited purpose, independent owner authorization and alert/audit; never agent self-grant.
Offboarding revokes tokens/delegations and scheduled actions; outstanding payroll/case obligations remain assigned.

School/district boundary applies to all provider projections and service references. Student-level service data stays in the school-authorized system; opaque references/approved aggregates must not permit unauthorized lookup or re-identification.

retention_policy_pointers.required_configuration: Purpose, applicable employment/consent rules, consent text, trigger, retention period, access scope and rights handling.
Applicable agreement/legal record requirements, effective version history, audit purpose, expiry trigger and hold rules.
Category-specific access, location and applicable record rules; store status/reference instead of report where sufficient.
Applicable jurisdiction/employer/time/wage/tax/accounting schedules and dispute holds; no erasure of owed-pay evidence.
Case class, necessary evidence, access, investigation/claim holds and disposal approval.
Minimum traceability and provider reconciliation window, masking, retention, immutable archive and controlled deletion.

retention_boundary: Launch requires approved category schedules, hold precedence and deletion/backup evidence. No legal periods invented. Withdrawal alone does not erase valid-purpose records.

checks: Every state reachable and every nonterminal has a terminal path
Public listing never creates client authority
validation_contract.execution_status: Structural design checks only; adapters, jurisdiction rules and operating behavior untested.

state_model_contract: All listed-state graphs are complete within the declared bounded object. Only listed transitions permitted. Terminal corrections create linked records. Cross-object validation and non-transition evidence operations remain mandatory.
command_contract_inheritance: command_type is commands.id or non_transition_operations.name; command_id is a UUID instance. Inherit envelope, DS-CMD-RULES and retry profile. Transition types join transition.command_id for actors/prerequisites; input_fields adds payload fields.
object_contract: Objects inherit DS-COMMON; object retention_policy_ref is normative. Only named masters own fields; transactional state changes require commands.

record_formats.decoding: Zip each row with its declared columns; all rows have exactly that column count.
record_formats.required_field_rule: Required_at_create controls initial presence. Deferred evidence may be absent initially; each transition requires its stated evidence. Types apply to present values.

command_input_type_rule: Inputs resolve to object fields; *_ref=reference, *_refs=array<reference>, *_id=uuid, *_hash=sha256, *_key=string, *_interval=zoned_interval, closure_reason=string. Validate adapter payload schemas before implementation.
